summary: Document the proposed contract for durable normalized GitHub facts in the GitHub plugin

replay.detail: Documentation only; no replay or projection changes.

schema.detail: No daemon, client-v0, stored format or generated-client contract changes.

rules.detail: No runtime or policy rule changes; the documented capture, coverage and fencing rules take effect only with their later implementation.

compatibility.detail: Existing GitHub plugin behavior, CLI flags and client contracts are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart, migration or service interruption.

manual.detail: No configuration, permission or manual migration is required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or recovery steps.
